$description: Library part w12A (wave 12, lane A): the iOS and Android counterparts of files and assets. Assets and collections are cards in a collection (Collections and File management on iOS; Card and Collection on Android); the file list is a list or a table (Lists and tables and Outline views on iOS; List and Data table on Android); the file browser is the system's file management with a sidebar of folders (File management, Sidebars and Outline views on iOS; File and photo pickers and Tree on Android); the upload manager is progress (Progress indicators on both); the version comparison is a split view (Split views on iOS; Window classes on Android). Merged with web-native-map.json by build-native-guidance.js.
